text.zh: 从递推式 aₙ₊₁ = p·aₙ + qⁿ（p ≠ q）出发，先用待定系数法凑出等比数列 bₙ = aₙ + qⁿ / (p − q)，求出通项 aₙ = (a₁ + q / (p − q))·pⁿ⁻¹ − qⁿ / (p − q)。再追问这种「变换系数」的做法背后是什么：借复数和 2×2 矩阵的对应引出线性变换，把递推写成状态向量乘矩阵 sₙ₊₁ = A·sₙ，用 Aⁿ⁻¹ 右上角的等比求和算出同一个通项。

text.en: Starting from the recurrence aₙ₊₁ = p·aₙ + qⁿ (with p ≠ q), the method of undetermined coefficients builds the geometric sequence bₙ = aₙ + qⁿ / (p − q) and gives aₙ = (a₁ + q / (p − q))·pⁿ⁻¹ − qⁿ / (p − q). The post then asks what this juggling of coefficients really is: by writing complex numbers as 2×2 matrices it arrives at linear maps, rewrites the recurrence as a state vector times a matrix, sₙ₊₁ = A·sₙ, and recovers the same formula from the geometric sum in the corner of Aⁿ⁻¹.
